subject.title: Preserve structured ACP backend error kinds instead of mapping all errors to `end_turn`

question: Should non-refusal Gateway chat failures in the ACP bridge reject `session/prompt` with structured JSON-RPC errors, or should they keep resolving `PromptResponse` while exposing structured failure data through another approved surface?
rationale: Gateway events already carry structured `errorKind`, but ACP stop reasons do not encode timeout or rate-limit classes and changing prompt settlement from resolve to reject is a client-visible compatibility decision.

options.title: Approve RequestError settlement after fixes
options.body: Use rejected `session/prompt` responses for backend failures after avoiding SDK code conflicts, keeping reconnect behavior intentional, and requiring focused tests plus real ACP proof.

options.title: Preserve resolved prompt responses
options.body: Keep existing resolved `PromptResponse` compatibility and expose structured failure data through an approved metadata or diagnostic surface.

options.title: Pause for replacement
options.body: Leave this issue open for a maintainer-led implementation if the linked branch cannot settle the compatibility contract and proof gap.
